hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that layers configurable hook fees (static, tiered, or adaptive dynamic with surge) onto every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, with automated distribution to buyback, reward conversion, and custom wallet recipients. Also enforces launch-protection buy limits per origin address, cooldown penalties for rapid repeat trades, and a referral fee system.
